title: Choose the look for the side panel and the floating chat
question: The roll assigned Batch Code. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Batch Code
options.lineage: continuous-inkjet batch and best-before codes printed on food packaging
options.thesis: Every answer carries its lot code: figures and issue keys stamped like batch codes, traceable to the row they came from.
options.viewport: Side panel under a carton-green header with a three-step flow; the chat floats over the Foresight page and stamps every figure, key and W/C date as a dot-matrix code.
options.risk: Dot-matrix type tips into novelty if it spreads beyond codes and figures.

raised.raise: State changes restyle a row in place (stamp colour, weight) and never move the grid.
Two type sizes in the panel; rank is carried by weight and case, not size.
Colour is quarantined: red and amber appear only inside stamps and status marks.
One 4px cell module governs every gap, so stamps and rows align to a visible rhythm.
Focusing a stamped code reveals its source (page, workstream, week) while the answer holds still.

options.label: Wall Planner
options.lineage: the laminated office year planner with coloured dot stickers
options.thesis: Resourcing as the office wall planner: weeks as columns, people as coloured dots, this week marked by a red string.
options.viewport: Side panel shows a week strip of dot-sticker allocations; chat answers about people draw the same strip inline.
options.risk: The most familiar candidate: closest to Foresight's own grid, so it may read as a copy of the board.

options.label: Monochrome Proof
options.thesis: Every claim in the chat is immediately followed by the evidence row that proves it.
options.viewport: Near-white panel, near-black type, answers paired with framed evidence rows, one blue accent for actions.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and holds product clarity, but nothing in it belongs to the client's world.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Workstreams as departures, flaps cascading on change.
options.viewport: A black board of workstream rows with flap cells.
options.case: Fuses poorly: stakeholders do not identify with a departure board, and a chat is not a board.
options.kept: Rows restyle by state without breaking the grid.
options.risk: Costume of an instrument on a working screen.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The grid itself as the visible armature.
options.viewport: Panel on a faint visible grid with monumental cell-built numerals.
options.case: Fuses poorly: poster-scale letterforms fight a 400px working panel.
options.kept: A single cell module that every gap snaps to.
options.risk: Reads as a poster, not a tool.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight, case and reversal.
options.viewport: Raked slides of timetable columns over a lit bed.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the rake and light bed obscure dense answers.
options.kept: Rank carried by weight and case rather than size.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.thesis: The focused item grows and explains itself while the rest dims.
options.viewport: Rows of workstream tiles that expand on focus.
options.case: Fuses poorly: entertainment browsing is the wrong register for stakeholder reporting.
options.kept: Focus reveals an item's source without moving its neighbours.

options.label: Lexicon Shoulder and Plate
options.thesis: Black text at a fixed measure; colour quarantined in bordered plates.
options.viewport: Answers set as dictionary entries with guide words at the head.
options.case: Fuses poorly: scholarly reading pace suits neither the panel nor quick questions.
options.kept: Colour lives only inside bordered marks.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS side panel with a stepper and a chat bubble widget, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: White panel with numbered steps; a blue launcher opens a bubble chat bottom-right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other assistant by design.
